title: Check Power of Two

content.problemStatement: Find whether the given number is power of 2 or not.

solution.approach: Check if integer is a power of 2 using bitwise check (n > 0 and (n & (n - 1)) == 0).
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: A positive integer is a power of two if and only if it has exactly one bit set in binary: (n > 0) && ((n & (n - 1)) == 0). Print 'YES' or 'NO'.

hints: Powers of 2 have exactly one 1 bit in binary representation.
The expression n & (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit.
learningObjectives: Understand binary representation of powers of 2.
Solve divisibility properties in O(1) time.
